Connecting you with the Netherlands
The world is facing immense challenges. Working together and sharing our knowledge and expertise are crucial. The Netherlands is reaching out to international partners, based on a firm belief that partnerships and collaborations are the only way forward. Together we can make a difference.

Themes
Human rights

Human rights are the cornerstone of human dignity, freedom and development and form the basis for open and free societies all over the world. The Netherlands strives to defend human rights, both at home and abroad.

Select a country
Sustainability

The world is facing complex social and environmental challenges with the current ways of production and consumption. The Netherlands strongly believe that a transition to a circular economy is key. A change is needed.

Select a country
Agriculture and horticulture

In the face of a growing population, we must reimagine our food system. How can we produce food that benefits both producers and consumers without harming our planet? We collaborate with global partners to cocreate.
